{{Quote|How many Rebels are you taking?''"<br />"''Ninety. Plus two medical droids.''"<br />"''Acknowledged. That information will be relayed to Imperial command.|The Imperial controller confers with Zuckuss|<ref name="OfPossibleFutures" />}}
An '''individual''' served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Controller/Legends|controller]] aboard a [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. She communicated with [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], concerning the ninety [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] that he was rescuing from a downed [[Bright Hope/Legends|transport]]. The controller informed him that the information would be relayed to [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial command]].
